job.purpose: Untouched-family census, the fresh listing: Kalshi's full series list (category, frequency, fee type) and every non-combo market that settled on one full day, Nov 10, 2026 UTC, for counts and volume by family. No candle, no test, no rule scored.
job.heldout: none (a listing: counts, volume and descriptive fields only; no test is scored from it)
job.notes: Order matters: the whole series list first, then 24 hourly windows of settled markets (combos left out, at most 3 pages of 1,000 an hour, so about 120 MB at 1.7 KB a market, under the 200 MB run cap), then the series list again by single-word category as a fallback in case the whole list is cut at the 5 MB answer cap. The /series call with limit 20000 and the /markets call with mve_filter=exclude and close-time bounds are the calls V2's sweep used (src/scalper/usweep2.py). The category parameter on /series is the one call not seen in that code: it is placed LAST so that a refusal cannot stop anything before it. An hour with more than 3,000 settled markets is cut and shows a cursor on its last page: the reader reports it as a lower bound.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
